name: Jumping in the City
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final square mobile game app icon for an urban rooftop parkour game named Jumping in the City.
Create a polished, striking premium mobile game icon. One athletic ADULT male parkour runner, short dark hair, coral-orange athletic shirt, charcoal cargo joggers and white-soled dark sneakers, captured in a powerful forward running jump between two city rooftops. Dynamic side/three-quarter view, face partly visible in profile, torso upright leaning forward, one knee driving upward and the other leg trailing, arms counterbalancing naturally. Anatomically correct, confident clean parkour action, no somersault. The character must be the large unmistakable focal point, taking up about two thirds of the frame height.
Composition: square 1:1, visually simple bold silhouette, strong diagonal movement from lower left toward upper right; the entire runner including fingers and shoes fits within a safe central area so the icon remains readable when cropped into a circle or rounded square. Two chunky rooftops emerge from the lower corners, with a clear gap between them. A compact layered city skyline in the background provides depth without clutter.
Style: premium stylized 3D game key art, beautifully modeled architecture and character, clean graphic shapes, rich but controlled detail. Bright golden-hour sunlight along the character's edges, warm orange highlights on concrete roof edges, cool teal and deep blue city shadows, luminous pale turquoise sky. Dramatic light and atmosphere with crisp focal detail, no gritty noise. Energetic adventurous city parkour mood, excellent contrast and legibility at small launcher-icon size.
Background fully opaque and filled edge to edge; square canvas with no premade rounded corners and no outer border. No words, letters, title, logo, watermark, UI, phone mockup, additional people, traffic, signs, extra limbs, motion streaks obscuring the character, fisheye lens, excessive small architectural details, or generic superhero costume. Deliver the icon artwork itself, not a presentation board.
